resources.string: Everything goes into one encrypted .peachy file: videos with covers, saved galleries and pages, history, tags, notes, bookmarks. The PIN and device settings stay on this phone. The file can be large.
Enter the password the file was exported with. Imported data is added to the library; nothing on this phone is overwritten or deleted.
There is no way to recover the file without this password.
Added %1$d videos (%2$d already here), %3$d galleries, %4$d notes.
Wrong password, or the file is damaged.
This is not a Peachy file.
The file was made by a newer version of Peachy. Update the app.
The file is damaged or incomplete. Nothing was imported.
Not enough free space on this phone. Nothing was imported.
Could not read or write the file.
Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
